title: harness.config.json
description: How the harness builds outputs: tag and CSS prefix, adapters, feature switches, references and white-label guard.

docs.description: Rendering parameters for the documentation pages (spec/design-docs.json, docs/design-docs/). The only absolute in the doc shell.

width.description: Doc root width in px; every other size is a token or a grid span.

available.description: false disables sync and drift checks for the tool; everything else keeps working.

features.description: Process switches read by the rules and slash commands (advisory: checks do not depend on them).

agentProfiles.description: Sketchbook agent integrations selected for this project (sketchbook init --agent). An empty list is core only.

claudeExtras.description: Optional Claude-layer groups installed in this project (sketchbook init --with); harness/manifest.json "optional" lists their files.

starter.description: The starting point chosen with sketchbook init --start (harness/starters/<id>.json).

harnessVersion.description: Version of the harness-owned files (harness/manifest.json), bumped by sketchbook upgrade.

source.description: true only in the repo harness/catalog is built from: check G1 then keeps the catalog equal to the components.

contextBudget.description: Bytes of the Claude layer that are in context in every session: CLAUDE.md, rules without paths:, model-invocable skill and command descriptions, and what the SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and SubagentStart hooks print (check H1, SB-0114).
